custodyProfile.uncertainty: The MG999 fund is a sub-fund of the Delta Master Trust, a Singapore unit trust under MAS regulation managed by FundBridge Capital, with an independent trustee and custodian, Vistra as administrator, and Standard Chartered providing banking and gold-side attestation. The trustee and custodian are not named, provider shares are unknown, and token-holder legal claims have not been documented because the token has not launched. Gold leases are true leases of personal property with title retained by the lessor and gold held outside lessee bankruptcy estates.
